questions.instructions: `hook` is the one line always shown for a stored memory note and `body` is the full note. Does the trigger in `hook`, the situation it says the note applies to, name the situations `body` actually covers, so a reader in one of those situations would recognise the hook as meant for them?

criteria.true: the trigger names the situations the body covers
criteria.false: the trigger is missing, too vague, or names other situations than the body covers
